question: Should ClawHub staff hide/quarantine, rename, or leave the `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex` listing after reviewing the public ShieldCortex ownership evidence?
rationale: The requested action changes a live third-party listing and depends on staff rights/moderation judgment; current source code provides process and tooling but cannot decide the claim automatically.

options.title: Hide or quarantine during review
options.body: Use existing skill moderation controls to remove the disputed listing from public install/search while staff evaluates the claim or contacts the publisher.

options.title: Rename or reserve after acceptance
options.body: If staff accepts the evidence as conclusive, rename/alias/reserve the disputed namespace with an audit note.

options.title: Ask for more proof or decline
options.body: If the public evidence is insufficient, request private proof or leave the listing active with a documented decision.

recommendation.title: Hide or quarantine during review
recommendation.body: Use existing skill moderation controls to remove the disputed listing from public install/search while staff evaluates the claim or contacts the publisher.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied by history to the current namespace-claim docs and staff moderation surface used to adjudicate this kind of issue.
